inv.desc_en:
Transfer: €115,000

Modern premises, with a license for a music bar + provision of sexual services of 60 m², distributed on one floor, with 1 entrance, 5-meter glass facade and with a capacity for 30 people, designed to enjoy a sound experience.

It has a 7-meter bar with 11 stools, equipped with refrigerators, a beer tap and a POS machine. The premises are soundproofed and have a sound limiter, TV and music equipment.

It has 2 toilets, air conditioning and storage. Slot machine

Rent: €1,527
Contract: 10 years
Incasol deposit: 2 months
Additional guarantee: to be assessed.
